decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through contacts build on the firm's core structuring and bonding know-how and fit its packaging-wafer direction, so the sunk development effort and strategic fit favor keeping them.

Carrier wafers for smaller diameters are a low-cost extension of the established carrier business and match the announced push into reusable carriers, so management has little reason to withdraw them.

The Cu-interposer was publicly launched at SEMICON Europa as a flagship of the advanced packaging direction, so heavy investment and public commitment strongly favor persisting even if adoption is slow.
The Wafer Universe brand was founded as a flagship line of off-the-shelf products close to the core business, making it cheap to sustain and visibly tied to the firm's identity.

Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the core offer and received the least visible commitment, making them the likeliest to be dropped, but the R&D already invested and weak results that can still be blamed on the pandemic period favor keeping them for now.
